long_biography.plain_text:
Claudio Galeno began as Francisco Javier Pujante Pérez’s vocational-education venture in Murcia, with early programmes centred on healthcare professions and emergency services. He was sole shareholder and administrator of the founding training company, giving him direct responsibility for both ownership and operations. Agreements with public institutions later placed students in practical emergency-services settings.

Pujante expanded into broader vocational study and digital delivery through Universae. His next project moved into private university-level health-sciences education through Universidad Internacional Mundae. The institution combines academic study with clinical simulation, supervised practice and hospital placements. As its founder and chief executive, he continues to develop education businesses built around career preparation and applied learning.
